text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I came to a shrine with 
Yukino Bijin, who said she hadn't been 
feeling in top shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I just haven't been feeling 
like myself lately...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An' come to think of it, I haven't prayed 
lately. Back home, I used to pray at the 
household shrine every mornin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, wishing to spend today in good 
health, wishing for clear skies, wishing 
for a bountiful harvest, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'd fallen out of the habit, so I figured 
I might as well do it here too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin tossed a coin into the 
offering box and pressed her hands 
together in prayer with a serious look.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, all finished! Everything should be 
fine now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep-boop-beep...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the phone's ringing. What could it be, 
I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? Ah, yes! Please leave it in 
my room, will ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, looks like that blessing worked 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san contacted me to say she got 
a ton of rice and vegetables sent from 
home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, right! How about I treat everyone in 
the dorm to some food with the gifts we 
received?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, we gotta hurry back and get 
ready! Let's head back to the academy, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, her motivation restored, Yukino 
Bijin got back on top of her game.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the phone's ringing. What could it be, 
I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-What!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Crows are tearing up the academy's 
fields...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I hung up some CDs to 
scare them off... Crows in the city really 
are clever, huh."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I gotta head back and figure out a 
strategy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shocked, Yukino Bijin slumped her 
shoulders. It seemed she hadn't managed to 
get back in top shape.
